answer:
The highest-grossing film of all time is **Avengers: Endgame** (2019), which earned approximately **$2.94 billion** worldwide. This film was directed by the **Russo Brothers** – **Anthony and Joe Russo**.

While Avatar holds a notable position just below it (around $2.92 billion), both were released in recent years, though Avatar also benefited from 3D re-releases over time. Both films rank as some of the most successful in cinema history in terms of nominal box office revenue.
